description: This file defines the internal class StreamDirectory within the Orleans.Streams namespace, responsible for managing streams associated with a silo, including creation, cleanup, and disposal logic.

classes.name: StreamDirectory
classes.description: Internal class managing streams associated with a specific silo, providing methods for stream retrieval, cleanup, and disposal.

methods.name: GetOrAddStream
methods.description: Retrieves an existing stream by its identifier or creates and adds it if it does not exist, ensuring type safety for the stream's data type.

methods.name: Cleanup
methods.description: Performs cleanup of streams, optionally cleaning producers and consumers, with safeguard to skip cleanup during testing.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears all stored streams from the directory, primarily for testing purposes.

methods.name: GetStreamControl
methods.description: Retrieves the stream control interface for a specific stream, if available.

methods.name: GetUsedStreamIds
methods.description: Returns a list of all stream IDs currently in use within the directory.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously disposes of the directory, cleaning up streams.
